description: This file defines an authentication service for a Flutter/Dart project, including user data models, authentication methods (login, registration, token refresh, logout), and interaction with shared preferences and API client.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: Represents an authenticated user's profile with id, name, and email fields.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides methods for user authentication, session management, and token handling, supporting both mock and real API interactions.

methods.name: AuthService.create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create an instance of AuthService, determining mock mode based on environment config.

methods.name: hasToken
methods.description: Checks if a valid authentication token exists in shared preferences.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user's profile from shared preferences.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes all stored session data from shared preferences, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, either via mock data or real API, and stores session info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Creates a new user account, supports mock and real API modes, and stores session data.

methods.name: requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Initiates password reset process via API or mock delay.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Refreshes the authentication token, either by returning a mock token or calling API.

methods.name: _fetchMe
methods.description: Fetches the user's profile information from the API.

methods.name: _persistSession
methods.description: Stores session data including tokens and user info into shared preferences.
